summary: FidelityManager accepts undeclared extra keys in otherwise valid input and configuration records.
evidence: PR 385 exact head 827ce0cf63ca5f322502de883beb9f43581c69f2 validates declared fields but has no exact-key check or extra-key regression.
MaterialDNA PR 75, WorldEntity PR 76, and ObjectGenome PR 94 use exact record shapes at comparable plain-data boundaries.
PR 419 changes the registration ceiling only and inherits this record-shape behavior.
recommendation: Add bounded exact-key validation and extra-key regressions in the retained Fidelity integration lineage without changing F0-F4 behavior.
